# mimecast_dmarc_delegated_domains (Data Source)

Read complete typed DMARC Analyzer delegated-domain configuration with cursor pagination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_dmarc_delegated_domains" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable delegated-domain inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `details` (String) Delegated-domain status details.
- `dkim_delegation_status` (String) DKIM delegation status.
- `dmarc_delegation_status` (String) DMARC delegation status.
- `dmarc_policy` (String) DMARC policy.
- `domain` (String) Domain name.
- `hash` (String) Delegation hash.
- `id` (String) Delegated-domain ID.
- `spf_delegation_status` (String) SPF delegation status.
